selection_rule: Among configurations that, in BOTH F1 and F2: (a) add at most 30 extra alerts beyond E4's 100/day on EVERY whole simulated day (strict daily cap, not an average), (b) catch more frauds that E4 missed than E4 itself catches when given the same total number of extra review slots (its next-ranked transactions), and (c) catch at least 1.0 extra fraud per day on average; choose the one with the most extra frauds over F1+F2. Ties: higher extra precision, then fewer active rules. If none qualifies, recommend no backstop alerts (rules give reason codes only).
confirmation_rule: The selected configuration is confirmed only if conditions (a) and (b) also hold on F3.
